quote: Duox2 and Duoxa2 mRNA were increased during the induction and resolution of DSS colitis, while Lpo expression did not increase during the acute phase.
summary: Duoxa2 mRNA rises during induction and resolution of DSS colitis in mouse colonic crypts, supporting H2O2-driven healing.

quote: A predicted damaging mutation in the gene SLC26A3 is potentially associated with increased expression of DUOX2 and DUOXA2 in rectal tissue.
summary: In Icelandic UC patients an SLC26A3 variant is potentially linked to increased DUOXA2 expression in rectal tissue.

quote: SDR significantly upregulated expression of Dual oxidase 2 (Duox2), Dual oxidase maturation factor 2 (Duoxa2), and inducible nitric oxide synthase 2 (Nos2) in IECs (2- to 8-fold, p < 0.0001), effects reversed by β-AR blockade but not α2-adrenergic, CRH, or glucocorticoid inhibition.
summary: Social stress raises epithelial Duoxa2 expression in mice, reversed by beta-blockade; the oxidase inhibitor apocynin eased colitis but Duoxa2 itself was not targeted.

quote: A novel subset of epithelial cells expressing high levels of DUOX2 and DUOXA2 (DUOX2-epi) was discovered.
summary: Single-cell RNA-seq of Crohn's disease finds a DUOX2/DUOXA2-high epithelial subset in the inflamed colon tip that signals to monocytes.

quote: Assay for transposase-accessible chromatin using sequencing revealed more open chromatin around the aquaporin 8 gene in HCs (P = 2.0 × 10-2) and more around the DUOX2/DUOXA2 locus in inflamed UC colon (P = 5.7 × 10-4), suggesting an epigenetic basis for differential protein expression by epithelial cells in health and disease.
summary: The DUOX2/DUOXA2 locus has more open chromatin in epithelial cells of inflamed UC colon, with DUOX2 protein raised.

quote: Two siblings also had heterozygous dual oxidase activator 2 (DUOXA2) mutations.
summary: Case report of a CYP4V2 family in which two siblings also carried heterozygous DUOXA2 mutations; not related to UC.

quote: Genetic defects in DUOX2 or DUOXA2 can result in congenital hypothyroidism, whereas partial defects in DUOX2 activity also have been associated with very early-onset inflammatory bowel disease.
summary: Methods chapter on reconstituting DUOX/DUOXA enzymes in cells; notes DUOXA2 defects cause hypothyroidism and DUOX2 defects link to early-onset IBD.

quote: Here, we performed global expression profiling on germ-free mice colonized with C. albicans and found that Duox2 and Duoxa2, encoding a dual NADPH oxidase activity, were upregulated in the ileum and colon.
summary: Candida albicans colonization induces Duox2 and Duoxa2 in mouse gut via IL-17 signalling, which limits fungal colonization.

quote: An IBD score from 18 genes (e.g., DUOXA2) reflecting inflammatory pathways provided complementary discriminatory information and resolved this overlap.
summary: DUOXA2 is part of an 18-gene tissue IBD score that distinguishes active IBD from eosinophilic colitis.

quote: Nine genes were overexpressed in both regions (TCL1A, DUOXA2, CC18, S100A8, CHI3L1, PTGDS, MMP3, CXCL1, and GREM1).
summary: DUOXA2 is one of nine genes overexpressed in ileum and colon of pancolitis patients; the paper focuses on CHI3L1.

quote: Eight common hub genes (CCL11, CCL20, DUOX2, DUOXA2, LCN2, NOS2, PDZK1IP1, and TRIM40) were ultimately selected through integrated ML approaches.
summary: DUOXA2 is one of eight hub genes shared by IBD and cholangiocarcinoma; only LCN2 and DUOX2 were validated as markers.

quote: SDR significantly upregulated expression of Dual oxidase 2
summary: Preprint version: social stress upregulates epithelial Duoxa2 in mice via beta-adrenergic signalling, alongside worse colitis.

quote: TPO, DUOX2, DUOXA2, IYD, SLC26A7, DUOX1
summary: DUOXA2 is one of 32 congenital hypothyroidism genes sequenced; no DUOXA2-specific result and no UC relevance.

quote: CLDN2: claudin 2
summary: CLDN2 appears only in the abbreviation list of an autophagy-in-IBD review.

quote: CLDN2: claudin 2
summary: CLDN2 appears only in the abbreviation list of a review on autophagy and the epithelial barrier.

quote: Some claudins show a proximal expression pattern, such as CLDN18 which is solely expressed in the stomach, and CLDN2 and -15 that are predominantly expressed in the proximal parts of the gastrointestinal tract.
summary: CLDN2 mRNA is mainly proximal in the healthy gut and claudin expression changes in IBD depend on location and inflammatory activity.

quote: The HC diet modified ileal mRNA expression of Myo9b, and Cldn1 and Cldn2, but left Ocln expression unaltered.
summary: A diabetes-preventing diet changed ileal Cldn2 mRNA in diabetes-prone rats alongside better barrier function; not a colitis study.

quote: Most notably, claudin-2 expression was significantly increased and correlated with increased intestinal permeability.
summary: EHEC infection in mice raises colonic claudin-2 expression, correlating with increased permeability.

quote: Acute deletion of Atg7 in mice increased CLDN2 levels and the susceptibility to experimental colitis.
summary: Autophagy degrades pore-forming CLDN2 via AP2M1 and LC3 to tighten the barrier; higher CLDN2 raises permeability and colitis susceptibility.

quote: The results showed that dietary STE supplementation normalized LPS-induced changes in protein expression of p-NF-κB and p-IκBα, mRNA expression of inflammatory genes (TLR4, NF-κB, and IFN-γ), tight junction-related genes (CLDN2, OCLN, and ZO-1), and antioxidant genes (Nrf2 and HO-1).
summary: CLDN2 is one of several tight junction genes normalized by stevioside in LPS-challenged chickens; no CLDN2-specific result.

quote: AQP9 together with CLDN2 may have a role regulating tissue-specific physiological properties in tight junctions in UC.
summary: CLDN2 is among the differentially expressed genes in treatment-naive UC biopsies and is suggested to affect tight junction properties.

quote: The expression of 20 selected genes was assessed using quantitative reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction in 26 colorectal cancer, 42 adenoma and 24 normal mucosa samples.
summary: CLDN2 is among 20 junction genes, upregulated in colorectal tumors versus normal mucosa; not a UC study.

quote: And CLDN2 depletion significantly promotes N-myc downstream-regulated gene 1 (NDRG1) transcription, leading to termination of the CRC growth and metastasis in vitro and in vivo.
summary: CLDN2 knockdown suppresses colorectal cancer growth and metastasis through NDRG1; no colitis outcome.

quote: Human IBD/colon cancer specimens demonstrate decreased SMAD4, CLDN4, CLDN7, and CLDN8 and increased CLDN2 compared with healthy controls.
summary: Cldn2 rises with intestinal Smad4 loss in mice, and CLDN2 is increased in human IBD and colon cancer specimens.

quote: Overall, expression of CLDN2 or CLDN4 alone had a strong prognostic value that increased when they were associated.
summary: CLDN2 is upregulated in colorectal cancer and has prognostic value for survival; not a UC study.
